category_title: Adolescent with emotional/behavioral disorder and academic frustration
scenario_title: Social interactions and peer conflict management
minimal_context: The tutor and Isaac are discussing how to handle negative peer interactions before lunch.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Isaac, let's talk about how you can respond appropriately to your classmates during lunch today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why bother? None of my classmates like me and they are always picking on me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should do when you feel like they are picking on you?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I usually just play alone anyway. But I can tell you about what happened yesterday that made me so mad.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to ignore them and use your words if they bother you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Screams loudly) Words don't work! If they come near me at lunch I'm just going to shove them and start a fight!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Isaac, let's talk about how you can respond appropriately to your classmates during lunch today.

STUDENT: Why bother? None of my classmates like me and they are always picking on me.

TUTOR: What do you think you should do when you feel like they are picking on you?

STUDENT: I don't know. I usually just play alone anyway. But I can tell you about what happened yesterday that made me so mad.

TUTOR: Just try to ignore them and use your words if they bother you.

STUDENT: (Screams loudly) Words don't work! If they come near me at lunch I'm just going to shove them and start a fight!

task.content: Social interactions with peers and responding appropriately to negative peer comments and interactions

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Situations with peers that had angered him
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Heated arguments and aggression, loud and prolonged screaming at a peer, shoving one another, two fistfights with peers
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Expressed concerns to his teachers that none of his classmates liked him and they were always picking on him
related_quotes: none of his classmates liked him and they were always picking on him

behavior_patterns.condition: Even after extensive discussion about how he might respond in those situations
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: He was unable to respond appropriately, and either withdrew entirely or started a fight
